node.text: PSSR Sieve. Trim the birth-time range using relevant precessed solar return contacts.
The Sieve. Explore birth-time intervals with secondary progression constraints.
Polaris2. Scan candidate birth times against a biography of dated events.
Birthtime Convergence Matrix. Compare bands of time and exact contacts across events.
TPD Anchor Mapper. Find exact birthtimes implied by high-scoring TPD event contacts and inspect where events converge in birthtime and RAMC.
Contact Navigator. Move to the previous or next event-relevant primary direction.
TPD Three-Time Compare. Compare three candidate birth times live against the same event using primary directions.
Epoch Chart Finder. Find five lunar crossings before birth and highlight the one closest to 273 days before birth.
Epoch / Radix Directions. Compare Epoch and natal primary directions, including contacts between the two charts.
Dual-Test · Radix & Epoch Studio. Compare radix, epoch and their interaction across nine panels of primary directions, secondary progressions and PSSR.
Age Harmonics. Calculate internal age harmonic aspects for an event, with category highlighting and ratings.
Age Harmonics Research. Research age harmonics using database charts and dated events, with a Power write-up across the event list.
Age Harmonics Hitlist. Find exact age-harmonic contacts over a date range, with event-category points, full orb windows and text exports.
Age Harmonics Live. Watch the current age-harmonic chart update with the clock, or select a date, with glyphs and aspect connections.
Midpoint Lab. Explore midpoint structures on 45° and 22.5° dials or trees, with Witte reference context and optional hypothetical planets.
Fixed Star Parans. Inspect fixed stars on the angles and daily parans, with natal, current-time and live views.
Central Scrutinizer. Load database cases and life events into nine connected systems, with shared birth data, highlighting and exports.
Studio Hitlists. Follow chronological lists of exact contacts across seven systems, with event-category highlighting and ratings.
Timeline. Explore primary directions, secondary and tertiary progressions, and outer-planet transits together on a zoomable timeline.
TPD Pair Timeline. Compare two factors in both directions on a calendar, with orb spans, life events and Isaac-weighted event aspects.
TPD Event Timeline. Compare event-relevant primary directions with dated life events on a shared timeline.
TPD Event Meters. Review weighted primary-direction scores across life events using compact meters and inspect each event’s contacts.
Cusp Category Graph. Graph cusp-axis activity and normalized event-category scores across selected systems over time.
House Activation Timeline. Explore twelve houses across nine systems with a heatmap, house-activation graph and contact inspector.
Category Activation Timeline. Explore event-category activation over time with a heatmap, category graph and weighted-contact inspector.
Topocentric Primary Directions. Calculate primary directions for a single date or a date range.
TPD Bi-Wheel. View direct or converse Topocentric Primary Directions alongside the natal chart in a bi-wheel for a selected date.
PSSR Aspects. Inspect, sort and highlight precessed solar return aspects.
Lunar Angles. Explore planets on the angles in lunar returns for events.
Solar Contacts. Compare and filter contacts across four solar returns.
New Partner Horoscope. Calculate the older partner’s prenatal and younger partner’s postnatal charts at their meeting location.
Event Convergence Scanner. Find recurring themes across directions, arcs, progressions and transits.
Aspect Overlap Finder. Select event-related aspects across systems to find their shared in-orb dates.
Ascensional Transits. Compare the event sky with natal ascensional positions, including conjunctions, oppositions and antiscia.
Ascensional Transits Hit List. List exact direct and converse ascensional contacts chronologically across a selected time range.
Ascensional Transits LIVE. Watch a live ascensional wheel with recent contacts, upcoming contacts and countdowns.

Your tools stay independent. Birth details, events and calculations remain inside each tool. Open tools keep their state while the app stays open. Use each tool’s own save or export controls before closing it.
